fusions.name: Boarding Swing
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away for a chop that deals 13 damage and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Heeling Sweep
fusions.desc: Leans into a full sweep that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignores armour. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Running Before the Wind
fusions.desc: Carries you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Wind Filling the Sail
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (25% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
